payload.text: NEVER RUN fleet doc WHILE FLEET LIVES IN DEVBIN: it writes every install outside the roots into a tracked doc, a client's among them, and fleet audit prints the same list to stderr. Audit output stays in scratch, and only numbers go into a commit or a resolution. Found 2026-10-05 while measuring the client-name exposure; the census doc last generated on 2026-09-22 names no client.
